# 🐞 Bug Report

## 📋 Summary

Provide a short and clear description of the issue.

> Example: "The login page crashes after clicking the Sign In button."

---

## 📌 Bug Description

Describe what happened.

- What did you expect to happen?
- What actually happened?

---

## 📍 Affected Area

Select all that apply.

- [ ] Frontend
- [ ] Backend
- [ ] API
- [ ] Database
- [ ] Authentication
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other (please specify)

---

## 🔄 Steps to Reproduce

Follow these steps to reproduce the issue:

1. Go to `...`
2. Click on `...`
3. Enter `...`
4. Submit the form
5. Observe the error

---

## ✅ Expected Behavior

Describe what you expected to happen.

> Example: "The user should be redirected to the dashboard."

---

## ❌ Actual Behavior

Describe what actually happened.

> Example: "A blank page appears with a 500 Internal Server Error."

---

## 📷 Screenshots / Screen Recording

Attach screenshots or videos if applicable.

> Drag and drop images here.

## ✔️ Checklist

Please confirm the following before submitting.
